notes.title: More changes to the token mechanics for Inferno
notes.content:
I thought over the new token mechanics for the Inferno pack again and came to the conclusion that it could be too complicated, given the already difficult game for the Hell pack. Therefore, I left only 2 types of tokens that give mana infusion: an infernal token, which will be given by the Inferno Tower, Ifrit, Cerberus and Devil, and a token filled with mana, which will be given by all other Towers.

A token filled with mana is a strong token that can strengthen a Tower without sacrificing economy, and I think this will allow you to survive on Ascensions.

Which was the purpose of the introduced mechanics.

In the future, I will think about this mechanics some more and try to carefully refine it.

By the way, the mechanics of additional bonuses for high Ascensions are also currently being prepared. And, of course, a new pack of towers is being developed.

notes.content:
Version 0.74a
[h3]Added auto buy. Auto buy must first be enabled in the gameplay settings.

When you press 'E' or double-click on a Tower placed on the field, that Tower will be marked. If Towers of the same type appear in the Tower Store, they will be bought immediately.

- Q + 2 for Frog potion
- Q + 3 for Regeneration potion
- Q + 4 for Vigor potion

notes.title: Balancing of the Royal Towers and the nearest plans
notes.content:
[b]In addition to fixing bugs and all sorts of technical stuff, I really want to do further gameplay design, especially the actual action of the Towers themselves.[/b].

[b]My immediate plans are as follows:[/b].
[h3][list]
[*] Revision of the Towers from the Royal Pack.
[*] Revision of the Towers from the Inferno Pack.
[*] New Towers.
[/list][/h3]


[h2]Revision of the Towers from the Royal Pack[/h2]
In previous updates, I have done work on the towers of the Royal Pack.
[list]
[*] Builder Tower: Gives 3 more HP.
[*] Thief Tower: more trap damage starting at level 4.
[*] Hydra Tower: bonus increases slightly with each level.
[*] Glass Tower: increased bonus growth starting at level 3
[*] Chest Tower: increased gold growth starting at level 3.
[/list]

It is also worth noting that such towers as Cat Tower, Cow Tower, and Butler Tower have been improved since the demo. But these improvements went straight into the release.

In addition to this, one crown is now now restored after going to the second act. Also one crown is restored when entering endless mode.


[h2]Revision of the Towers from the Inferno Pack[/h2]
[b]In the near future I'm going to think about the Inferno Pack Towers. Some of them should get some minor changes, and some of them should probably be completely redesigned.[/b]


[h2]New Towers[/h2]
The Guild Tower (for the Royal Pack) is currently in development. Several new Towers are also being drawn for the Royal Pack, and new Towers are being drawn for the Inferno Pack.

I don't know exactly how I'm going to bring the new Towers into the game. Maybe I'll have to make a separate, beta branch in Steam for them, in order to properly test these new Towers. But maybe there will be another way.

All of the above are immediate plans. Of course, there's a whole other set -- the Neromancer Pack, but that's a separate, major task. So I'm not describing it for now. 

Stay tuned, and thanks for your comments about the game!

[*] Incubator Tower (new mechanics)
[*] Spire Tower (x5 experience gained)
[/list]

[b]I'll probably go into more detail about these changes later. But for now I will read the feedback, and try to fix all possible bugs as soon as possible :) And then I'll get to the new content and some possible balance tweaks.[/b]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44446957/274d88875f6c2d773fe6e02a9ede596a492a8d7f.png[/img]
The Royal pack is available in the demo right now. But, there will be other tower packs in the game besides the Royal pack. For example, I am currently working on the Inferno pack.

This pack will have its own list of towers -- i.e. the common, uncommon, and rare towers will be different from the Royal pack.

In detail, the main tower will be the Inferno Tower, which gives mana, and instead of the “Reroll” skill has the “Infuse Mana” skill. (However, you can get the Reroll in other ways, for example, by using the Chaos Tower or the Whirlwind Tower)

Above and below are screenshots from the Inferno pack.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44446957/1208d07955fa71d2b0d0b38b51bc1c23777cb090.png[/img]

Right now the pack has 7 common towers, 10 uncommon towers and 5 rare towers. I have to make 6 more towers to make the number of towers equal to the Royal pack.

All in all, it turned out to be quite a lot of work. However, I believe that the different packs are fun! 

As one of the solutions (to ensure that the game will be released this autumn) I see the release of the game in early access with two packs (Royal and Inferno), third and fourth act, difficulty levels, endless mode, etc. And then finalize new packs (like the Necromancer pack) during early access. If I decide to do so, I will additionally inform about it.

notes.title: Behind the Scenes: REROLL
notes.content:
This week I added a major change to the game: REROLL

Because, there's no public demo yet, and you don't quite have an idea of what the game looks like, I'll try to explain it in more detail.

In Epic Auto Towers, there is a "Tower Store." Every turn, random towers are generated there, which you can then buy and place on the field. Something similar can be seen in Super Auto Pets and Backpack Battles. But unlike the above games, Epic Auto Towers didn't have a reroll button that allowed you to generate new towers in the tower store in the same turn.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44446957/06e15bd86e519bbb789c9f75d0c9fe408dd46dab.png[/img]

There were a few reasons for this. First of all, when I first started making the game, there were not many towers available. At that time I had already tried adding a reroll button, but I didn't like it. The game became too easy with the reroll, and getting the right towers didn't evoke enough emotion. Besides, I wasn't going to replicate everything exactly like Super Auto Pets, so the differences were fine with me in a way.

But as development progressed, the number of towers increased and the game got longer. More towers made it too difficult to get the towers you needed for your chosen strategy. (And there will be even more towers, I have a lot of ideas for them!). Because of the increased length of the game, a different problem arose. By the end of the second act, the field for towers was completely filled and in some cases there was nothing to do. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44446957/16ff959249ac74a0ce31bbbaebbf0b66fe69bfb1.png[/img]

A reroll, however, could solve both of the above problems. With reroll it is easier to "drop" the right tower, despite the large number of different towers. As for filling the field: in Epic Auto Towers, towers can be upgraded by combining them with towers of the same type, so the reroll helps to get the right towers for that combination. So once the field is filled, gameplay continues. (Without reroll, the Towers needed for the matchup would drop too infrequently).

As a result, the reroll was added to the game this week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44446957/5e3390924d84606064c3c26f72603def3c3dc5ca.png[/img]

I've already played with the reroll and loved it.

notes.title: Epic Auto Towers!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I came up with the idea for this game over a year ago, after playing Super Auto Pets. I really liked it and felt inspired to make a game in a similar genre (but I wanted it to be a single player game).

I created a prototype. The prototype turned out to be interesting, with a lot of differences from Super Auto Pets, and that was good too. However, everything just looked like squares that you place on the field, without any visuals :)    

For quite a while the game was in suspense because of this. There seemed to be no way to find a graphical style for the game. And finally, at the beginning of this year, the artist kotikomori drew the Cat Tower and the Milk Tower exactly as it seems these towers should look in Epic Auto Towers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44446957/ca7e71db72d4da89e2046fa813773c5f5892ddfd.png[/img]

After that, the development of the game went into full speed, and today is the day to announce that Epic Auto Towers will be released on Steam!

Add game to wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2116060/Epic_Auto_Towers/
